undici.compatibility: Same major as Pi's 8.10.2 and inside openai's >=5 <9. Pi's http-dispatcher uses Client, Pool, EnvHttpProxyAgent, install and setGlobalDispatcher, all in 8.12.3.

minimatch.compatibility: 11.0 drops makeRe(), Minimatch#regexp, AST, matchOne() and debug; Pi only calls minimatch(path, pattern, { nocase }) in model-resolver and package-manager, which 11.0 keeps.
